mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SF_REPORT (MEMBER_ID, DISASTER_TYPE, CONTENT, LATITUDE, LONGITUDE, PHOTO_URL) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{disasterType}, #{content}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{photoUrl,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.select: SELECT r.*, m.NAME AS REPORTER_NAME FROM SF_REPORT r JOIN SF_MEMBER m ON r.MEMBER_ID = m.MEMBER_ID WHERE r.INCIDENT_ID IS NULL ORDER BY r.CREATED_AT DESC
SELECT r.*, m.NAME AS REPORTER_NAME FROM SF_REPORT r JOIN SF_MEMBER m ON r.MEMBER_ID = m.MEMBER_ID WHERE r.INCIDENT_ID = #{incidentId} ORDER BY r.CREATED_AT ASC
